name: Give_5
short_caption: The robot extends both hands forward with open palms turned upward in a giving gesture.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot raises both hands, rotating its wrists so that the palms face upward. It extends its hands outward toward the user in a gentle giving or offering motion. The robot holds this position briefly before smoothly retracting both arms back to its sides, returning to the neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The robot extends its arms forward; ensure there are no obstacles or people directly in front of the robot within arm's reach.
